Bachchan father-son receive death threat from gangster

Actors Amitabh Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan have reportedly received death threats. The threats are attributed to gangster Goldy Dhillon, who allegedly posted on social media that a "bulletproof cabin won't save them." The incident has sparked concern, particularly in Mumbai.
